# Test fixtures

`portrait.jpg` is a 192×192 head crop of the `astronaut` sample image shipped
with [scikit-image](https://scikit-image.org/) (`skimage/data/astronaut.png`):
the official NASA portrait of astronaut Eileen Collins (NASA image
GPN-2000-001177). As a work of the U.S. federal government it is in the
public domain. It is used only to exercise face detection in tests and is not
part of the ComfyUI package (`tests/` is excluded by `.comfyignore`).
